signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to open templates in the editor and save your sheets.

confirmEmail.title: Check your email
confirmEmail.pasteHint: You can paste the whole code — it fills the cells for you.
confirmEmail.spamHint: No email? Check your spam folder.

forgotPassword.title: Let's get you back in
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with. We'll send a code to set a new password.
forgotPassword.prefilledHint: Filled in from the sign-in form.
forgotPassword.googleHint: Signed up with Google? You don't need a password —

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.instructions: If an account with {{email}} exists, we sent a code to it. It's valid for 1 hour.
resetPassword.devicesHint: Changing the password signs you out on other devices.

resetDone.title: Password changed
resetDone.signedInAs: You're signed in as {{name}}. Other devices will need to sign in again.
resetDone.fallbackMessage: Sign in with your new password — your email is already filled in.

notice.codeResent: A new code was sent to {{email}}
notice.emailConfirmed: Email confirmed. Sign in to continue.

errors.emailAlreadyExists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.invalidCode: The code is incorrect or expired.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.passwordTooWeak: Password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, a digit, and a special character.
errors.providerError: We couldn't send the email. Please try again shortly.
errors.emailMissingDomain: Check the address — the domain is missing
errors.network: Network error. Please check your connection.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.message: Sign in again — this page will stay right where it is.
